name: AI Pathfinder
description: A predictive auto-dodge assistant. Looks ahead with shadow players and plays the surviving input pattern, tick-exact.

practice-only.name: Practice Mode Only
practice-only.description: Only assist while practice mode is active.

safe-mode.name: Safe Mode
safe-mode.description: Marks assisted runs as test runs so nothing is saved or submitted.

horizon.name: Look-ahead (ticks @ 240 TPS)
horizon.description: How far into the future a plan must stay alive.

segment.name: Decision Step (ticks)
segment.description: Input granularity after the first tick. The first decision is always 1 tick, which is what makes frame-perfect inputs possible.

budget-ms.name: Time Budget (ms per search)
budget-ms.description: Max CPU time per search. Raise for tight sections, lower if the game stutters.

replan-ticks.name: Forced Re-plan Interval (ticks)
replan-ticks.description: Plans are reused between searches. This forces a fresh search regardless, to catch things the shadow cannot see (triggers, moving objects).

divergence.name: Divergence Tolerance (units)
divergence.description: If the real player drifts further than this from the prediction, the plan is thrown away and re-searched.

show-path.name: Show Predicted Path
show-path.description: Draws the plan like Show Trajectory. Green = holding, white = released.

show-status.name: Show Status Label
show-status.description: Small label: Clear / Dodging / No Path, plus search cost.
